pages.text: Problem: Four credits for one coin Solution: tell apart old and new PCBs: 1, Older PCBs are marked as part no. A038156, and newer PCBs are part no. 038575. 2. Barly PCBs have large 40-pin chips located near their centers. Newer PCBs have these chips along one edge, away from the edge connector.
